description_en: When you use Function Compute for the first time, you can call this API operation to activate Function Compute by using identity credentials (such as an AccessKey pair or a Security Token Service (STS) token) that have the OpenFcService permission
description_zh: 首次使用函数计算服务时，您可以使用有OpenFcService权限的身份凭证（如访问密钥、临时安全令牌）通过API开通函数计算
name: OpenFcService
